answer: Because the saffron index resolves every citation against the ferrous checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the nebula audit keeps the resolved set. Copying the same citations across 199 aliases therefore forfeits the authoring cost 199 times while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. A farm of 1584 identities would post 4307 proofs and burn roughly 88 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
